notes.title: We've Launched Our YouTube Channel!
notes.content: [p]🎬 We've just launched our official [b]LEKANO WORLD ONLINE[/b] YouTube channel! [/p][p][/p][p]This is where we'll be posting all devlogs, trailers, and behind-the-scenes content - starting now. [/p][p][/p][p]And here's the best part: [/p][p]💡 If you're part of our Discord community, **you'll get access to every video 24 hours early**, before it goes public. [/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]We need your support now more than ever.[/b] Since you're among the first to see it - your full watch, like, and comment (or even a couple!) can really help this video - and future ones - reach more people.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]Watch here:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/e_8FIiUGZoE"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We're just getting started - and your early support means everything. [/p][p]Stay tuned for upcoming [b]DEVLOG[/b] videos, gameplay previews, and deep dives into the world of Lekano. [/p][p][/p][p][i]- Artur Lekano[/i][/p]
